    properties:

service:
  auth: false
  base-path: ''
  endpoints:
    createMessage:
      path: /accounts/{accountId}/regions/{regionCode}/messages
      method: POST
      source:
        openapi: ../openapi.yml
      request:
        name: CreateMessageRequest
        path-parameters:
          accountId:
            variable: $accountId
          regionCode:
            variable: $regionCode
        body:
          properties:
            body: string
        content-type: application/json
      response:
        docs: Created
        type: CreateMessageResponse
        status-code: 200
      examples:
        - path-parameters:
            accountId: accountId
            regionCode: regionCode
          request:
            body: body
          response:
            body:
              sid: sid
  source:
    openapi: ../openapi.yml
